symptoms_reported: Checkout failing at the payment step; customers see "Something went wrong"
root_cause: Payment configuration deployed with a wrong setting
resolution: Rolled back the latest payment release

symptoms_reported: Customers charged twice for one order
root_cause: Duplicate payment requests after a timeout
resolution: Fixed the duplicate request handling and refunded affected customers

symptoms_reported: Search returns no results for any keyword; product pages still load
root_cause: Search index rebuild job failed and left the index empty
resolution: Restored the previous search index and re-ran the rebuild

symptoms_reported: Many products showing the wrong price on the website
root_cause: Bulk price import loaded a file with the wrong currency column
resolution: Reverted the price import and reloaded the correct file

symptoms_reported: Customers say the password reset email never arrives
root_cause: Email provider rate limit reached after a marketing campaign
resolution: Raised the rate limit and re-sent queued reset emails

symptoms_reported: Orders stuck in processing and no shipping labels created
resolution: Renewed the credentials and re-queued the stuck orders

symptoms_reported: Whole site very slow with 503 errors on many pages
root_cause: Web servers did not scale up during a traffic spike
resolution: Added capacity manually and fixed the autoscaling rule
